name: Snake's Mane

stealth.note: (trained) to discern the snake's mane from the surrounding vegetation

description: A tangle of feathery green vines appears innocuous but fires a spray of acidic barbs at anything that disturbs it.
disable: DC 27 Nature check (expert) to strip the barbs from the vines, rendering them harmless, or DC 30 Stealth check (trained) to move through the snake's mane without disturbing it
reset: 1 hour, as the vine grows a new set of barbs

offensiveAbilities.name: Barb Spray
offensiveAbilities.description:
A creature enters an area containing snake's mane or the snake's mane takes damage

Effect The vine sprays a hail of acidic barbs in a 10 foot emanation. Any creature in the area takes 4d10+18 acid damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is also Blinded for 1 minute.

Note: A saving throw for this ability was not provided by Paizo. The DC presented here is a hard DC for the hazard's level based on the GM Core hazard building rules.
